title: Independent
description: Protect the freedom to create, decide and grow without forcing every artist or release into the same commercial mold.

title: Artist Driven
description: The artist and the music come first. Decisions should support the people creating the work, not simply serve a release calendar or a spreadsheet.

title: Beyond Genre
description: Great music does not respect artificial boundaries. Different sounds, influences and creative identities belong in the same label universe.

title: Creative Freedom
description: Artists should have room to experiment, evolve and make the work they believe in without being pushed toward a predetermined house sound.

title: Partnership
description: A label relationship should be collaborative, transparent and mutually beneficial. QFR succeeds when its artists have the support to succeed.

title: Ownership
description: Artists should retain meaningful ownership and control of their creative work, with clear agreements and a fair path toward long-term catalog equity.

title: Quality First
description: A release should be finished with care. The goal is lasting work, not rushing music out simply to satisfy a deadline.

title: Evolution
description: Stay curious. Use new tools and ideas thoughtfully. Keep improving the sound, the process and the experience without losing the human intent.

title: Rising Tide
description: Build an environment where artists can lift one another up. Shared learning, collaboration and opportunity make the entire roster stronger.
